settingsDescription: Read-only connector for searching and importing files from the connected Google Drive account.
disconnectConfirmBody: The Drive folders synced into Knowledge from this Drive account are deleted from Liaison, with the documents and links made from them. Cached Drive content is deleted only when your organization's last Drive connection is disconnected. Files you imported and documents you wrote stay. Your files stay in Google Drive.

picker.title: Choose files for Liaison
picker.body: Pick the Google Drive files and folders Liaison can see. Liaison sees nothing else in your Drive.
picker.saved: {{count}} picked. Liaison is syncing them; you can close this window.
picker.failed: The picker could not be opened or saved. Try again from Liaison.
picker.expired: This link has expired or was already used. Open the picker again from Liaison.
picker.reconnect: Google Drive is not connected any more. Connect it again in Liaison, then choose your files.

card.title: Files Liaison can see in Google Drive
card.intro: With a personal Google account, you choose which Drive files Liaison can see.
card.syncError: The last sync did not finish. It runs again shortly.
card.notImported: not in Knowledge: {{type}} files have no text to import
card.notConfigured: Choosing files is not set up on this server yet. An administrator sets GOOGLE_PICKER_API_KEY and GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_NUMBER.
card.fullDrive: Liaison can search your whole Drive: there is nothing to pick.
card.popupBlocked: The picker window was blocked. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
card.openFailed: The picker could not be opened. Try again.

sharedDrives.title: Shared drives the team sees
sharedDrives.intro: An organization's Drive connection shares the shared drives you pick here, never anyone's My Drive. Everyone who uses this connection sees the files in them. Personal files stay reachable only through each person's own Drive connection.
sharedDrives.none: Pick the shared drives the team should see. Until then Liaison reads none of this connection's files.
sharedDrives.empty: This Google account is a member of no shared drive. Add it to each shared drive the team should see (any role), or connect with an account that is a member.
sharedDrives.memberNote: Only the shared drives this Google account is a member of are listed.
sharedDrives.failed: The shared drives could not be loaded or saved: {{message}}
sharedDrives.askAdmin: An admin picks the shared drives the team should see.
